learning_outcomes.text: Explain the navigation stack: perception, localisation, mapping, planning, control
Describe localisation and the idea of simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM)
Explain global and local path planning at a conceptual level
Reason about obstacle avoidance and dynamic environments
Identify sensors used for mobile robot navigation and their trade-offs
Assess safety and failure handling for autonomous movement

integrative_case: A logistics startup deploys autonomous carts in a busy warehouse: design the navigation stack, decide how the robot localises and replans around people and pallets, pick sensors within budget, and define safe behaviour when a sensor drops out.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
